plugins.name: browzer
plugins.description: Hybrid vector + Graph RAG search across indexed codebases and document workspaces, powered by the browzer CLI. Skills covering install/auth, workspace + doc ingestion, code + markdown search, dependency graph, async ingestion polling, workspace management, skill discovery (find-skills), one-shot repo bootstrapping (browzer-bootstraper), and a tier-aware end-to-end idea-to-merge dev workflow (brainstorming → probe-tier → generate-prd → scope-feature → generate-task → execute-task → code-review → receiving-code-review → regression-guard → feature-acceptance → finalize-feature → commit). A haiku probe at orchestrator Step 0.5 picks `tier ∈ {express, standard, full}` per feat; express skips PRD/scope/task-plan entirely (orchestrator inline-writes a compact PRD heading into BRIEF.md and a single TASK_01.md). State lives as plain markdown under `docs/browzer/<feat>/staging/` (six per-phase subfolders: planning/, tasks/, review/, review-lanes/, fixes/, acceptance/), gitignored; only `README.md` at the feat root is committed. Code-review spawns 4 mandatory Opus lanes — senior-engineer, software-architect, qa, regression-tester — plus a cheap haiku `pr-coherence` lane and N dynamic specialists; all receive diff + browzer deps (forward + reverse) + browzer mentions; the regression-tester scopes to baseline-failure detection against `main` via git-stash. Mutation testing is removed from the workflow entirely. Tests are authored inline by `execute-task`'s coder alongside the implementation; a hard-fail host quality gate (lint + typecheck + test; + build at tier=full when public API drifted) runs BEFORE the TASK atomic-renames to .completed.md. Receiving-code-review then closes EVERY finding with a 7-step ladder (sonnet → research → opus → research → log to tech-debt) for zero-tech-debt by default; haiku is forbidden for fix dispatch. The new `regression-guard` skill re-runs the host quality gate over the aggregate post-fix diff, routing failures back through the fix ladder for up to 3 rounds total. Feature-acceptance mode is tier-aware (smoke / hybrid / autonomous-with-stack-boot). Finalize-feature absorbs both host-doc patching (Phase A) and the committed README render (Phase B). Orchestrated by orchestrate-task-delivery; execute-task internally resolves serial / parallel / parallel-worktrees / agent-teams strategy with a capability probe. Universal subagent preamble requires `browzer deps --reverse` blast-radius probing before any edit; feature-acceptance anti-soft-override regex blocks autonomous flips of perception metrics without operator reply.
